snippet.title: Pony Island 2: Panda Circus - Steam Playtest Trailer | The Triple-i Initiative
snippet.description:
Learn more about Pony Island 2: Panda Circus: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2017940/Pony_Island_2_Panda_Circus/

Pony Island 2: Panda Circus is a phantasmagorical voyage through time, myth, divinity, and video games. Escape the lordly deities of the underworld with your soul and your sanity intact. This is not a game about ponies.

Sign up for the Steam Playtest NOW!

Pony Island 2: Panda Circus Store Page:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2017940/Pony_Island_2_Panda_Circus/

What is the Triple-i Initiative?

We’re simply a bunch of studios banding together to share exciting news to our players, in a short show packed with back-to-back trailers. That’s it - no extra fluff, no ads, no host, just games. We’re talking world premieres, exclusive gameplay, launch dates, demo drops and more!

You can learn more at https://iii-initiative.com
